subject: ClarityAI evaluation: success gauge, sprint gates, and ops owners
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & proposed success gauge for evaluation (latency/throughput/cost/quality)

Natalie — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a concrete proposal so we can get the sandbox moving: 

Summary of ask from your team:
- Validate model-led classification on your anonymized claims dataset (~45k records)
- Confirm end-to-end latency under realistic payloads
- Produce a cost baseline for 1m inference tokens/month

Proposed evaluation scope and success gauge (please review):
- Latency: p95 inference < 150 ms (single-request, 1k token cap)
- Throughput: sustained 50 req/s per shard during stress window (95% availability)
- Cost: target <= $0.002/token average for production-like mix (we'll publish per-variant estimates)
- Quality/accuracy: >= 92% F1 on your seeded test set and <1.5% false positive rate for the priority labels

Timeline (4-week sprint gates):
- Week 0 (this week): data access, credential handoff, sandbox provisioning (Redwood/dev)
- Week 1: smoke validation + functional correctness (owner: Monica)
- Week 2: baseline perf and cost measurement (owner: Ben)
- Week 3: reliability / failure-mode testing (latency and cache priming checks)
- Week 4: readout, artifacts, and next-step contract/pricing conversation

Owners (Redwood):
- Rafael: commercial lead / overall coordination
- Ben Carter: infra & perf lead (throughput/cost measurements)
- Monica Patel: eval rubric and quality acceptance (test set / metric computations)

Attachments: sample workload (clarityai_sample_workload.jsonl) and a short checklist for access.

Next steps for you: confirm the success gauge above, share an S3 read-only location for 1–2 sample files + contact for procurement so we can surface any contract constraints. Also flag any regulatory constraints (data residency) that would change the plan.

If that all looks good I'll schedule the sandbox kickoff with Ben and Monica tomorrow.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Natalie Chen <natalie@clarityai.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Clarity AI Procurement <procurement@clarityai.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed success gauge for evaluation (latency/throughput/cost/quality)

Thanks Rafael — that matches our internal notes and we appreciate the clear gates. A couple of quick clarifications from my side: 

- The 92% F1 target is fine as long as the test set reflects our current label distribution (we'll confirm).
- Data residency: our legal team insists that any PII stay in us-east-1; would Redwood be able to run the sandbox in a dedicated VPC in us-east-1?
- Procurement looped in: procurement@clarityai.com. They may ask for a short form SOW and a data processing addendum.

I'll share two sample files to the S3 path by EOD tomorrow. Also, can you send a short note on how you measure tokenization and what assumptions you use for cost/token? We want to align before week 2.

—Natalie
Natalie Chen
Head of ML Ops, Clarity AI
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed success gauge for evaluation (latency/throughput/cost/quality)

Natalie — perfect, thanks for the signal. Short answers to your asks and an ops split so procurement has clarity: 

1) VPC / region: yes — we can provision the sandbox inside a customer VPC in us-east-1. Ben will own the VPC setup and provide the network diagram + security checklist.

2) Tokenization / cost assumptions: we measure tokens using the same tokenizer used by the model variant we deploy (we'll list the tokenizer in the kickoff doc). Cost/token in our estimate is the aggregated compute + infra cost averaged over a representative mix (inference, KV cache overhead, autoscaling amortization). For week 2 we'll run synthetic and sample-driven passes to report per-variant cost estimates and a blended cost.

3) SOW / DPA: Rafael will share a short SOW draft and Monica will add evaluation acceptance criteria into an appendix for procurement to review.

Owners & immediate next steps: 
- Ben: VPC and sandbox network (deliverable by Fri 18 Sep EOD)
- Monica: evaluation rubric template + test set ingestion (deliverable by Mon 20 Sep)
- Rafael: short SOW draft and kickoff invite (deliverable by Thu 16 Sep COB)

I'll send a calendar invite for a 30m kickoff for Fri morning. If procurement needs earlier alignment I can join a separate readout.

Thanks — Rafael
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed success gauge for evaluation (latency/throughput/cost/quality)

Quick internal note: I'm standing up the VPC and provisioning the dedicated sandbox cluster today. Two asks for clarity before I lock sizes: 

1) Typical payloads — sample size & tokenization expectations? (Natalie said ~1k tokens cap for many records but can you confirm average payload length and 95th percentile?)
2) Concurrency profile — the 50 req/s sustained target: is that per-model replica or per-customer shard? I want to avoid overprovisioning.

I've attached a brief workbook with the throughput model I'm using (throughput_estimates.xlsx). Once we have sample files I can run a smoke sizing pass and commit to an instance class.

—Ben
Infra & Performance
Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Clarity AI Procurement <procurement@clarityai.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized success gauge and sprint gates — please confirm

Natalie / procurement team — quick consolidated summary following our ops thread and Ben's questions. Please confirm and we'll treat this as the working contract appendix. 

Agreed success metrics (final):
- Latency: p95 inference < 150 ms (measured on single-request, up to 1k tokens; we'll report p50/p95/p99)
- Throughput: 50 req/s sustained per-customer shard (capacity tests will include 60s sustained windows)
- Cost: blended <= $0.002/token based on evaluation mix; week 2 will surface per-variant delta and recommended quantization/job configs
- Quality: >= 92% F1 on seeded test set (Monica to publish scoring notebook and threshold logic)

Sprint gates and deliverables:
- Fri 18 Sep: VPC & sandbox up (Ben) — deliver network diagram and credentials for read-only S3
- Mon 20 Sep: rubric + ingestion script (Monica) — deliver scoring notebook and sample-run instructions
- Week 2 window: perf & cost baseline (Ben) — deliver per-variant cost sheet + throughput logs
- Week 4: final readout with artifacts + recommended next-step commercial options (Rafael)

Attachments: clarityai_sample_workload.jsonl (sample), throughput_estimates.xlsx (sizing workbook).

Action item for Clarity AI: please confirm the S3 path + a procurement contact for the short SOW (procurement@clarityai.com is already CC'd). Once you confirm we'll lock the kickoff for Fri 08:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
